claims.text: For \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), \(i=s-t+1,\ j=r-t+1,\ a=\min(n-r-i,r-j),\ b=\min(i,j)\); the lower-adjoined family generates \(J_v\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
The transposed/right-adjoined family is \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}\), and is the conjugate family. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 833-840]

In the \((i,j,p,c)=(2,2,3,3)\) interval, the ten lower-adjoined classes form a \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(Q=J/A_+J\). [artifact 527b9b1cd586e81294f01def5f51d30afb4c5919e505f335d85bd759ec0facf1; artifact fe0114a78a3f2045e7b37abfb47b72bebb85782ac6dc52bc0b3bcf6ce46b3e14]
Partition conjugation induces an automorphism of \(Q\), preserves \(A_+J\), and carries the certified lower-adjoined basis to the right-adjoined family.
Both specialized ten-element families minimally generate \(J\).
